items.question: Is TrackDraw a drone race track builder?
items.answer: Yes. TrackDraw is a browser-based drone race track builder for FPV race directors who need scale-accurate layouts, 3D review, sharing, and export in one workflow.

items.question: What is the best way to plan an FPV race track?
items.answer: Start with the field dimensions, place the obstacles you actually have, then review the route in 3D before sharing or exporting the plan. TrackDraw is built around that exact sequence.

items.question: Can pilots review the layout without an account?
items.answer: Yes. Share links open in read-only mode on any device, no account or app needed. Send it to pilots, judges, or crew and everyone sees the same published version.

items.question: Does it work on a tablet at the venue?
items.answer: Yes. The editor is touch-friendly, so quick adjustments on a phone or tablet are practical when the real venue forces a change.

items.question: What export formats are available?
items.answer: Export a Race Pack PDF, PNG, SVG, editable JSON, a flythrough video, or a portable viewer archive. Use the archive with a compatible external viewer for offline review.

items.question: Do I need an account to get started?
items.answer: No. Open Studio and start designing, saving on your device, sharing and exporting right away. An account adds cloud projects, teams, durable published links, gallery publishing, embeds and connections to compatible AI assistants.

items.question: Can I reuse a layout for a future event?
items.answer: Yes. Use Duplicate in Project Manager to make an independent copy for your next event. You can also save selections as reusable track sections, or export and import a full project as JSON.

items.question: Can TrackDraw help catch route problems before race day?
items.answer: Yes. The 3D preview and route review warnings help surface uneven spacing, rhythm breaks, and alignment issues before you share the layout or start building it.

items.question: Can my club work on tracks as a team?
items.answer: Yes. With an account, create a team and invite editors or viewers. One person edits a shared project at a time, while teammates can view and export it. Team owners and editors can publish or update a saved version for pilots and crew.

items.question: Can I use TrackDraw with an AI assistant?
items.answer: Yes. Connect a compatible assistant through MCP to work with cloud projects: prepare material lists, compare tracks, draft layouts or preview edits. You choose the permissions and approve proposed edits before they are applied. The assistant cannot publish tracks or change sharing.
